accounts.name: grant

instructions.name: initialize

gets one from `set_fee_config` instead.

accounts.name: treasury

instructions.name: launch_conviction

accounts.name: metadata

the collection's update authority so the declared size is binding.

accounts.name: creator

its fee stream.

accounts.name: collection

same guarantee a constraint here would give without decoding Core's

instructions.name: list_nft_auction

types.name: AmmPool
docs: Native constant-product AMM pool created when a bonding curve graduates.
Holds the migrated real SOL + remaining tokens; trades `x*y=k`. One PDA per mint.

fields.name: sol_reserves
docs: Real SOL in the pool (lamports held in this account, above rent).

fields.name: token_reserves
docs: Tokens in the pool vault.

types.name: AmmSwapEvent
docs: Emitted on every AMM swap.

types.name: AuthorityChangedEvent
docs: Emitted when protocol authority moves to a different wallet.
Authority gates every privileged instruction, so a handover is the single
most consequential administrative act — worth an indexable record rather
than only a silent field change.

types.name: BondingCurve
docs: Per-token bonding curve. One PDA per mint, seeded by mindshare tier.

fields.name: virtual_sol_reserves
docs: Virtual SOL reserves (seeded from the mindshare tier).

fields.name: virtual_token_reserves
docs: Virtual token reserves.

fields.name: real_sol_reserves
docs: Real SOL actually deposited into the curve.

fields.name: real_token_reserves
docs: Real tokens still held in the curve vault.

fields.name: token_total_supply
docs: Total supply minted for this token.

fields.name: creator_fees
docs: Creator fees accrued (lamports held in this account, claimable once verified).

fields.name: tier
docs: Mindshare tier this curve was seeded at.

fields.name: complete
docs: True once the curve has hit the graduation threshold.

types.name: CollectionAuction
docs: A whole mpl-core collection listed as a descending auction.
Deliberately not reusing `NftAuction`. A collection has no owner — only an
update authority — so it cannot be escrowed with a transfer the way an
asset is. This PDA takes the update authority instead, which means the
escrow, the sale and the reclaim are all authority reassignments rather
than transfers, and the two lifecycles never share an instruction.

fields.name: collection
docs: The Core collection being sold.

fields.name: creator
docs: Seller, who gets the update authority back on a reclaim.

fields.name: start_price
docs: Ceiling price in lamports.

fields.name: floor_price
docs: Floor price in lamports.

types.name: CollectionAuctionEvent
docs: Emitted when a collection listing ends — sold, or returned unsold.

fields.name: counterparty
docs: The buyer on a sale; equal to `creator` on a reclaim.

fields.name: outcome
docs: One of the `NFT_*` discriminants, shared with `NftAuctionEvent`.

fields.name: price
docs: Descending price actually paid, in lamports. Zero on a reclaim.

fields.name: fee
docs: Protocol fee charged on top of `price`. Zero on a reclaim.

types.name: CollectionListedEvent
docs: Emitted when a collection is listed for sale.
Separate from `NftListedEvent` rather than reusing it with the collection
in the `asset` field: a feed that can't tell the two apart renders a whole
collection as though it were a single piece.

fields.name: size
docs: Members at listing time — what the buyer is being offered.

types.name: ConfigUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when the protocol's trading economics are retuned.
Every field is the value in force *after* the call, supplied or not, so an
indexer reading one event knows the whole configuration rather than a diff
it has to replay from genesis to interpret.

types.name: ConvictionCurve
docs: Per-token conviction curve. Prices identically to the bonding curve
(constant-product virtual reserves) but every buy time-locks the holder and
early sells forfeit a penalty. One PDA per mint.

fields.name: lock_period
docs: Seconds a position is locked after each buy.

fields.name: early_exit_penalty_bps
docs: Penalty (bps) applied to proceeds when selling before unlock.

types.name: ConvictionPosition
docs: A holder's stake in a conviction curve. Seeded per (mint, owner). Each buy
re-locks the whole position until `unlock_time`.

fields.name: amount
docs: Base units currently held under this position.

fields.name: unlock_time
docs: Unix time at which the position unlocks (penalty-free selling).

types.name: CreatorClaimEvent
docs: Emitted when a verified creator claims accrued creator fees.

types.name: DutchAuction
docs: Per-token Dutch auction. One PDA per mint. Price descends linearly from
`start_price` to `floor_price` over `duration` seconds; bidders pay the
current price, so buying early costs more (fair launch, no front-running edge).

fields.name: start_price
docs: Ceiling price, lamports per whole token.

fields.name: floor_price
docs: Floor price, lamports per whole token.

fields.name: start_time
docs: Auction start (unix seconds).

fields.name: duration
docs: Auction length in seconds.

fields.name: total_for_sale
docs: Total base units offered for sale.

fields.name: tokens_sold
docs: Base units sold so far.

fields.name: real_sol_reserves
docs: Lamports of proceeds collected.

fields.name: tier
docs: Mindshare tier this auction was tagged at.

fields.name: complete
docs: True once sold out or settled after end.

types.name: FeeConfig
docs: The NFT market's own fee schedule, tunable without a redeploy.
Lives beside `Global` rather than inside it because `Global` is already
on-chain at a fixed length (see `FEECONFIG_SEED`), and it holds the NFT
numbers specifically: a trading fee and a marketplace fee answer different
questions and were never the same number, they were just stored as one.
Required by the instructions that charge it, never optional. An optional
override would let a buyer omit the account and pay the old, lower number —
the opposite of the perk discount, where omitting it only costs the caller.

fields.name: nft_fee_bps
docs: Fee on an NFT or collection sale, in bps of the sale price.

fields.name: promo_lamports_per_day
docs: Cost of one day of promoted placement, lamports.

types.name: FeeConfigUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when the NFT market's fee schedule changes.

types.name: GenesisAllocation
docs: How many units one wallet has taken from one token's genesis group.
Keyed by (subject mint, buyer) rather than counted on the buyer's NFTs: the
units are transferable, so a buyer who sold theirs on would otherwise be
free to come back and buy the cap again. What the cap limits is how much of
the run one wallet may take from the group, which is a fact about purchases,
not about current holdings.

fields.name: units
docs: Units bought from this group, ever.

types.name: GenesisBatchMintedEvent
docs: Emitted when units are minted into a group's collection.

fields.name: units
docs: Units created by this call.

fields.name: minted_units
docs: Running total minted, out of `total_units`.

types.name: GenesisGroup
docs: A token's fixed-price run of genesis fee-share NFTs. One PDA per subject mint.
Where `mint_genesis` issues one NFT to a named recipient on terms the creator
negotiated off-chain, a group is a public offer: N identical units, a fixed
price, one collection, and a cap on how many any single wallet may take.
The PDA is the collection's update authority for the group's whole life,
which is what makes `total_units` mean anything. If the creator kept it they
could mint extra units into the same collection at any time, and every
existing holder's share of the fee stream would quietly shrink — the buyer
would have no way to tell a five-unit run from a five-hundred-unit one. With
the authority escrowed here, the only path to a new unit is
`mint_genesis_batch`, which counts.

fields.name: subject_mint
docs: The token whose fee stream every unit shares.

fields.name: creator
docs: Seller of the units, and the collection's authority on a reclaim.

fields.name: collection
docs: Core collection holding the units; its update authority is escrowed here.

fields.name: price
docs: Fixed price per unit, lamports. Protocol fee is charged on top.

fields.name: share_bps
docs: Slice of the creator's fee stream each unit carries, in bps.

fields.name: total_units
docs: Units this group will ever contain.

fields.name: minted_units
docs: Units minted into the collection so far (<= `total_units`).

fields.name: sold_units
docs: Units sold so far (<= `minted_units`).

fields.name: per_wallet_cap
docs: Most units one wallet may buy.

types.name: GenesisGroupClosedEvent
docs: Emitted when a group is delisted and its collection handed back.

fields.name: sold_units
docs: Units that found a buyer before it closed; they keep earning.

types.name: GenesisGroupListedEvent
docs: Emitted when a token opens a fixed-price run of genesis fee-share NFTs.

fields.name: total_units
docs: Units the run will ever contain — the denominator a buyer's share is
judged against, and the number the escrowed collection authority makes
binding.

types.name: GenesisNft
docs: A fee-share genesis NFT: a transferable Metaplex Core asset minted to an
early participant of a specific token, carrying a `share_bps` claim on that
token's fee stream. One PDA per asset. (Claim routing wires up during the
fee-distribution pass.)

fields.name: asset
docs: The Metaplex Core asset backing this genesis share.

fields.name: owner
docs: Current owner at mint time.

fields.name: subject_mint
docs: The token whose fee stream this NFT shares.

fields.name: share_bps
docs: Fraction of the token's fee stream, in basis points.

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Accumulator snapshot (`accrued(share_bps, acc)`) at last settle.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: Settled-but-unclaimed fees.

types.name: GenesisPool
docs: Per-token pool of genesis fees, split pro-rata across that token's genesis
NFTs by `share_bps`. One PDA per subject mint.

fields.name: total_share_bps
docs: Sum of `share_bps` across the token's minted genesis NFTs.

fields.name: acc_per_share
docs: Cumulative fee per share-bps, scaled by `revenue::ACC_SCALE`.

fields.name: reserves
docs: Lamports of deposited fees still available to claim.

types.name: GenesisUnitSoldEvent
docs: Emitted when a buyer takes one unit out of a group.

fields.name: fee
docs: Protocol fee charged on top of `price`.

fields.name: sold_units
docs: Units sold from the group after this sale.

types.name: GenesisUnitsReclaimedEvent
docs: Emitted when a creator takes unsold units back out of a group's escrow.

fields.name: units
docs: Units returned by this call.

fields.name: minted_units
docs: Units the group still holds, sold and unsold together.

types.name: Global
docs: Protocol-wide configuration, created once at `initialize`.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin authority (may update config in later phases).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Destination for trading fees.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Curve trading fee in basis points.

fields.name: creator_fee_share_bps
docs: Creator's share of each trading fee, in bps of the fee.

fields.name: graduation_sol
docs: Real SOL raised at which a curve graduates.

fields.name: virtual_token_reserves
docs: Default virtual token reserves seeded into new curves.

fields.name: token_total_supply
docs: Total supply minted per launched token.

fields.name: token_decimals
docs: SPL mint decimals for launched tokens.

fields.name: tokens_launched
docs: Number of tokens launched through the program.

types.name: GraduateEvent
docs: Emitted once, when a curve crosses the graduation threshold.

types.name: IssuerConfig
docs: The dedicated key authorized to sign SAS attestations for `verify_handle`,
separate from `Global.authority` so the attestation issuer (a hot key held
by the `/api/verify` service) can rotate without touching the protocol's
admin key. Singleton PDA; absent until `set_issuer` is called for the
first time, in which case `verify_handle` still trusts `Global.authority`.

types.name: LaunchEvent
docs: Emitted when a new token is launched under any mechanism.

fields.name: mechanism
docs: One of the `MECH_*` discriminants.

types.name: ListingPromotedEvent
docs: Emitted when a listing buys promoted placement.

fields.name: promoted_until
docs: Where the promotion now runs to, after stacking onto any remainder.

types.name: MindshareState
docs: On-chain snapshot of a token's mindshare, sourced from the Switchboard feed.
Keyed by mint (works for any launch mechanism) and kept fresh by an
oracle-gated `update_mindshare` crank. Instructions that want to react to
attention (dynamic graduation, mindshare-weighted rewards) read this cheaply
instead of requiring a fresh oracle read in their own transaction. Separate
from the curve accounts so adding it never changes their layout.

fields.name: mindshare_bps
docs: Conversation share in basis points (e.g. 3.24% => 324).

fields.name: tier
docs: Tier derived from `mindshare_bps` at the last update.

fields.name: updated_slot
docs: Slot of the last oracle update (freshness for readers).

types.name: MindshareTier
docs: Mindshare rank tier supplied by the (trusted, off-chain) launch keeper.
Determines the curve's starting virtual SOL reserve.

types.name: NftAuction
docs: A Dutch auction for a single 1-of-1 Metaplex Core NFT (art/music verticals).
The asset is escrowed under this PDA (which owns it) until sold; price
descends from `start_price` to `floor_price`. One PDA per asset.

fields.name: asset
docs: The 1-of-1 Core asset being sold.

fields.name: creator
docs: Seller who receives the proceeds.

fields.name: start_price
docs: Ceiling price in lamports (absolute, for the single NFT).

fields.name: floor_price
docs: Floor price in lamports.

types.name: NftAuctionEvent
docs: Emitted when a 1-of-1 auction ends — sold to a buyer, or returned unsold.
`NftAuction.complete` is set by both paths, so account state alone can't
distinguish them after the fact; without this, an indexer had nothing to
read and a lister got no notice that their asset had sold.

fields.name: counterparty
docs: The buyer on a sale; equal to `creator` on a reclaim.

fields.name: outcome
docs: One of the `NFT_*` discriminants.

fields.name: price
docs: Descending price actually paid, in lamports. Zero on a reclaim.

fields.name: fee
docs: Protocol fee charged on top of `price`. Zero on a reclaim.

types.name: NftListedEvent
docs: Emitted when a 1-of-1 is listed, whether freshly minted or already owned.

types.name: PerkGrant
docs: A pending perk grant, awaiting the recipient to claim it.
Splits `mint_perk` into authorise-then-claim so the protocol can approve a
batch of task completions cheaply while each recipient pays for their own
Core asset. The authority still decides who gets one — this account IS the
authorisation, and `claim_perk` mints only when it exists.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Wallet allowed to claim; the only account this grant can mint to.

fields.name: level
docs: Level to mint at (1..=MAX_PERK_LEVEL).

fields.name: granter
docs: Refund target when the grant is consumed — whoever paid to create it.

types.name: PerkNft
docs: An upgradeable perk NFT record. The Metaplex Core asset's Attributes carry
the level/discount for display; this PDA is the on-chain source of truth that
trading instructions read to apply the holder's fee discount. One per asset.

fields.name: asset
docs: The Metaplex Core asset backing this perk.

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet the perk was minted to.

fields.name: level
docs: Current level (1..=MAX_PERK_LEVEL).

fields.name: discount_bps
docs: Trading-fee discount granted, in basis points **of the fee** — 1000 is
10% off whatever the fee happens to be, not 10 bps off it.
Cached for display and for the IDL; `level` is the source of truth. The
trading instructions recompute from `level` so a perk minted under older
terms isn't stranded on them.

types.name: PoolCreatedEvent
docs: Emitted when a graduated curve's liquidity migrates into a native AMM pool.

types.name: Promotion
docs: Paid placement for one listing.
Kept in its own PDA rather than as fields on `NftAuction` and
`CollectionAuction`. Adding fields to either would lengthen an account that
already exists on-chain, and every listing created before the change would
fail to deserialize against the longer struct. A separate account also lets
one instruction promote both kinds, since it keys off the subject rather
than the listing type.

fields.name: subject
docs: The asset or collection whose listing is promoted.

fields.name: payer
docs: Most recent payer. Informational — anyone may top up a listing.

fields.name: promoted_until
docs: Unix seconds through which this listing ranks as promoted.

fields.name: total_paid
docs: Lifetime lamports spent here, for breaking ties between listings whose
promotion is otherwise equal.

types.name: RevenueShare
docs: Per-token revenue-share pool. Shares are sold at a fixed `share_price` and
entitle the holder to a pro-rata cut of deposited revenue, tracked with a
cumulative `acc_revenue_per_share` accumulator. One PDA per mint.

fields.name: share_price
docs: Fixed acquisition price, lamports per whole token.

fields.name: shares_sold
docs: Shares sold (== total staked, since buying auto-stakes).

fields.name: total_staked
docs: Total shares currently entitled to revenue.

fields.name: acc_revenue_per_share
docs: Cumulative revenue per share, scaled by `revenue::ACC_SCALE`.

fields.name: revenue_reserves
docs: Lamports of deposited revenue still available to claim.

types.name: RevenueStake
docs: A holder's revenue-share stake. Seeded per (mint, owner).

fields.name: staked_amount
docs: Shares held (base units).

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Accumulator snapshot: `accrued(staked, acc)` at last settle.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: Settled-but-unclaimed revenue (banked when stake changes).

types.name: TokenMetadataArgs
docs: A launched token's name, symbol and metadata URI.
One argument rather than three loose strings: they are meaningless apart,
every launch instruction needs all of them, and passing them separately put
two of those instructions over clippy's argument limit. Grouping also means
a future field arrives without changing five signatures again.

types.name: TradeEvent
docs: Emitted on every curve trade (buy or sell).

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Gross SOL spent (buy) or net SOL received (sell), in lamports.

fields.name: token_amount
docs: Tokens received (buy) or returned (sell), in base units.

types.name: Verification
docs: On-chain record binding a verified X handle to a wallet and its soulbound
credential NFT. One PDA per subject wallet. The authoritative "this handle is
really this wallet" state; the Metaplex Core asset is the user-visible badge.

fields.name: subject
docs: The verified wallet.

fields.name: asset
docs: The soulbound Metaplex Core asset minted as the credential.

fields.name: handle
docs: The X handle (without leading @).
